infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Songbird uses the camera to scan codes when you link a device or verify a contact, to take photos and videos you choose to send, and for video calls. Nothing it sees leaves your device unless you send it, and what you send is end-to-end encrypted.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Songbird uses the microphone for calls, and for voice messages you choose to record. Your voice goes only to the people in the call or chat, end-to-end encrypted.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Songbird uses your location only when you choose to send where you are, and only once. It goes only to the person you send it to, end-to-end encrypted.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Songbird saves the photos and videos you choose to your library. It can't see what else is there.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Songbird uses Face ID to open the app when you turn on unlock with Face ID. Your face data never leaves your device.
